summary: Ventura County fire district lookout built 1933 on South Mountain near Santa Paula; used for detection until 1974, now housing radio equipment, and registered in 2010.

facts.design: 14 by 14 ft cab on a 10 ft brick base, per the register; the district's history calls the tower concrete block
facts.status_note: No longer used for fire detection; maintained to house radio equipment, and listed as converted to a communications facility

events.note: May 1933 newspaper announcement of a new county lookout station on the ridge; to begin as a tent with an operator and a telephone

Register says constructed in 1933; the county fire district's history says the district built its own concrete block tower that year; a July 1933 newspaper says Civilian Conservation Corps men were working on the trail and a tower was being constructed
August 28, 1957: the lookout reported smoke; Fillmore firemen were dispatched to a grass and sagebrush blaze
Sence Ranch brush fire burned the roof off the tower
District operated the tower every fire season until 1974

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A July 1933 newspaper says Civilian Conservation Corps men were working on the trail and a tower was being built under the county fire warden. The district's later history says the district built its own tower in 1933. Both may be partly true; the story reports both and does not name one builder.
The register describes a 10 ft brick base under a 14 by 14 ft cab. The district history calls the tower concrete block. The story notes the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: No public access or visit information was found, so facts.access and visit are omitted; the record's access 'unknown' stands. The record's kind 'two_story' is not stated by any source; the register describes a 14 by 14 ft cab on a 10 ft brick base, so the kind may be a shorthand worth checking. Height was not found. Builder (CCC vs district) and base material (brick vs concrete block) disagree across sources; the story reports both. The conversion to a communications facility is undated. The register's 1949 photo credit (Los Angeles Times) is noted but no image URL was found, so no photo entry. The 1974 end-of-staffing date (district history) and the 'at least 1962' register line are consistent, not in conflict. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list is a chapter page; the 'comms fac.' row is the only source for conversion.
